title: Makeshift Bow
summary: Skeleton bow adds 1d10 Necrotic to its normal Piercing damage.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d6 Piercing plus Dexterity and 1d10 Necrotic, 60 ft. Martial two-handed ranged weapon, Dippable.
fields.Hamstring Shot: Action, ranged weapon damage. Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 or movement speed is halved for 2 turns. Once per Short Rest with proficiency.
fields.Availability: Animate Dead skeleton equipment. Patch 8/Hotfix 31 PC reports transferring it with the summon inventory preview. This is not a normal loot drop.
fields.Base value: 16 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
